sourceBasis: Same previously verified owned landscape names, original world frame dimensions and anchors. Independent muted A redesign: separated slender grass blades with no connected ground mass; sparse small flowers. Local original comparison informed scale and open structure, not a traced copy. Static sprites; 2 source pixels per world pixel, native generated high-resolution artwork proportionally downsampled into the original frame. Per-prop brightness is an artistic map-rendering calibration: ordinary .76, dark .55, deep .40; not extracted original luminance.
